nb7e7031559.headline: Kenya Wants Foreign Investment Aligned With National Interest Amid Tata Chemicals Row - Sing

nff1aa9e7df.why: Attacks on warehouses and logistics disrupt food distribution and raise costs for retailers and consumers. Supply chain damage is a key factor in war-related economic risk.

n33c85a704c.headline: Explainer-What is the yen carry trade?
n33c85a704c.summary: The yen surged to a seven-month high, prompting investors to ask whether the yen carry trade is ending. The trade has been a pillar of global markets.
n33c85a704c.why: The yen carry trade involves borrowing cheaply in yen to invest in higher-yielding assets, so a stronger yen can force position unwinds across markets.
n33c85a704c.why_moved: The yen's surge to a seven-month high raised concerns that the yen carry trade, a major source of global funding, could be unwinding.

nc3b16cd680.headline: FY27 Guidance and Three-Year Outlook

n44fcead1c7.headline: Stock Market Indexes Drop, But One Megacap Gained 6.3% - AOL

n1a17203bc7.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield rose Wednesday after the Treasury Department announced it would buy back $6 billion in bonds. The buyback was an effort to ease recent market wobbles.
n1a17203bc7.why: The 10-year Treasury yield is a benchmark for global borrowing costs. Treasury buybacks are a tool to manage market liquidity and government debt.
n1a17203bc7.why_moved: The yield rose amid market uncertainty, even as the Treasury announced a $6 billion bond buyback aimed at easing recent wobbles.

na90b94a88b.headline: US strikes Iranian oil tankers, Iran retaliates with attack on US base in Jordan; Brent crude climbs $1.57 - BusinessToday

n59b67808cb.headline: US destroys five Iranian oil tankers near Kharg Island

naad03eff0f.headline: 2 US vessels hit after 5 Iranian oil tankers destroyed: How the war escalated again

naad03eff0f.why: The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most important oil transit chokepoints. Attacks on shipping there disrupt crude flows and raise insurance and freight costs.
